titleEn: Collecting a parcel at the post office
canDoYue: 你識報追蹤號碼、出示身份證、畀海關費、話個箱有損壞，同埋簽名收件。
canDoEn: Give the tracking number, show your identity card, pay the customs fee, note the damage on the box, and sign for it.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: My tracking number is HK four eight two. Can I collect this parcel?
dialogue.glossYue: 我嘅追蹤號碼係 HK 四八二。可唔可以攞呢個包裹？
dialogue.say: My tracking number is HK four eight two. Can I collect this parcel?

dialogue.speaker: cole
dialogue.text: Yes. That tracking number matches the parcel. Please show your identity card.
dialogue.glossYue: 可以。追蹤號碼同包裹吻合。請出示身份證。
dialogue.say: Yes. That tracking number matches the parcel. Please show your identity card.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Here is my identity card. Do I also pay a customs fee?
dialogue.glossYue: 呢張係我身份證。使唔使再畀海關費用？
dialogue.say: Here is my identity card. Do I also pay a customs fee?

dialogue.speaker: cole
dialogue.text: Yes. The customs fee is forty dollars, and you can pay it here.
dialogue.glossYue: 使。海關費用係四十蚊，你可以喺度畀。
dialogue.say: Yes. The customs fee is forty dollars, and you can pay it here.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: This corner of the box looks damaged. Can you note the damage?
dialogue.glossYue: 個箱呢隻角睇落損壞咗。可唔可以記低損壞？
dialogue.say: This corner of the box looks damaged. Can you note the damage?

dialogue.speaker: cole
dialogue.text: Yes. I will note that damage, and the box is split.
dialogue.glossYue: 可以。我會記低損壞，個箱裂開咗。
dialogue.say: Yes. I will note that damage, and the box is split.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Where do I sign my name for the box before I leave?
dialogue.glossYue: 我走之前喺邊度簽名收呢個箱？
dialogue.say: Where do I sign my name for the box before I leave?

dialogue.speaker: cole
dialogue.text: Please sign on this line, and then the box is yours.
dialogue.glossYue: 請喺呢行簽名，之後個箱就係你嘅。
dialogue.say: Please sign on this line, and then the box is yours.
